sloka: अथ सम्स्कार सम्पन्नो हनूमान् सचिव उत्तमः ।उवाच वचनम् श्लक्ष्णम् अर्थवन् मधुरम् लघु ॥६-१७-५०॥।।
transliteration: atha samskāra sampanno hanūmān saciva uttamaḥ ।uvāca vacanam ślakṣṇam arthavan madhuram laghu ॥6-17-50॥।।

translations.english: On the other hand, Hanuman who was endowed with rich culture spoke these soft, sweet, and meaningful words briefly.
